long_biography.plain_text:
Trained in engineering and international business in Stockholm, Carl Mikael Wiren became chairman of Hoist Finance in 1994. Through Beagle Investments, he participated in the 2004 buyout of the debt-management company. He later held one of its largest stakes as the business expanded across Europe and prepared for a public listing.

Wiren also became Paradox Entertainment's largest shareholder and served as chairman, helping finance a company built around film, television and character rights. He briefly led its US operation before leaving the executive role. He later founded ROC, an entertainment-development and financing company, where he serves as chief executive and chief financial officer.
